scope_rules: Every Chakma response is eligible, including complete phrases, hyphenated compounds, inflected responses and repeated witnesses.
Bengali prompts are source glosses/controls, not Chakma forms; retain their script without invented English translation.
Retain source comma/slash alternative boundaries and scope parentheticals such as abbreviation/disparaging labels.
Do not count wrapped text as another row: p54 woman response annotation, p55 name-reference alternatives, p57 certificate Bengali prompt wrap.
Empty vertical gaps are layout, not unfilled lexical prompts.
Compare installed forward entries by literal form AND source sense/provenance; do not discard reverse chapter merely because a head recurs.

examples.scope: Complete Bengali descriptive prompts: sitting with knees folded; suddenly becoming startled. Must retain full Chakma responses.
Whole prompts include wetting earth into mud, spreading legs while standing, drinking in sips; all belong to source scope.
